source: Arcadis 2020, Sections 9-11 (PDF p.21-29). Withheld. Confirmation: Green WIN phase 2 summary p.9-11 (check valves later removed, specific energy fell 3-14%).

items.engineers: An unknown head loss of ~6 m at 300 l/s exists in the rising main.
Likely cause: intermediate NRV stuck/damaged with flow passing through the DN250 bypass with its gate valve open; system curve with bypass matches site data.
leak_phrases: flow would pass through the bypass

items.engineers: Removing the restriction gives ~15-20 l/s more with 2 pumps at 48 Hz (266 -> ~280 l/s, +5-7%).
High vibration of pumps/plinths/pipework is the probable cause of short bearing and seal life; structural survey and plinth replacement for Pumps 1 and 2, improved anchorage.
leak_phrases: replace the plinths under Pump 1 and Pump 2

items.engineers: Transient surges likely contribute to gasket failures: thrust supports, tie all flexible joints, move/change NRV, longer stop/start ramps.
leak_phrases: transient pressure surges may be contributing

items.engineers: Energy savings options: better level control, impeller change with IE3 motors, possible VSD removal (offset by frequency-response income).
